description_en: Adds a user to a user group
description_zh: 调用该接口将用户添加到用户组
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual add-face-user-to-user-group --isolation-id ZheJiangHZ --user-id 3mtjaqebeq4d0000 --user-group-id kvjy0000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddFaceUserToUserGroup

parameters.help_en:
The business isolation ID, which is used for data isolation between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account.

<notice>
The user and user group must be under the same isolation ID. Set this parameter to the same value as the IsolationId specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html operation to add the user and the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288341.html operation to create the user group.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
业务隔离ID，用于同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据隔离。

<notice>
用户和用户组，必须在同一个隔离ID下。请与调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html接口添加用户，和调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288341.html接口创建用户组时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致。
</notice>
parameters.name: isolation_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID. Specify the user ID that you obtained and saved locally after calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html operation to add the user
parameters.help_zh: 用户ID。请传入在调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288338.html接口添加用户后，获取并保存到本地的用户ID
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The user group ID. Specify the user group ID that you obtained and saved locally after calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288341.html operation to create the user group
parameters.help_zh: 用户组ID。请传入在调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288341.html接口创建用户组后，获取并保存到本地的用户组ID
parameters.name: user_group_id
